Davies Veterinary Specialists (http://vetspecialists.co.uk/) is one of the largest and most diverse small animal veterinary referral centres in Europe. Founded in 1998 Davies now employs more than 40 specialist clinicians and 60 nurses. We’re committed to providing your pet with leading multi-specialist care.

Davies Veterinary Specialists is part of Linnaeus Veterinary Ltd (A Mars Company). You
can find our terms of use and privacy policy by visiting: Privacy statement -
https://www.mars.com/privacy Legal notice - https://vetspecialists.co.uk/legal-notice/
Contact Information - https://vetspecialists.co.uk/how-to-find-and-contact-us/
